{{Top|leg}}
'''Gauss balls''' were a kind of [[Stun grenade/Legends|Stun grenade]] that were used for [[Droid/Legends|droids]]. They released a blast of ion and electrical energy. [[YVH-Series battle droid]] models had a resistance to these devices.

In [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Legacy of the Force: Inferno]]'' to [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]].</ref> junior [[Galactic Alliance Guard]] member [[Ben Skywalker]] struck a [[Tendrando Arms]] [[Guardian (Tendrando Arms)|Guardian droid]] with a gauss ball, only to discover that its [[mag-shielding]] had been sufficiently upgraded from military standards to resist the [[Weapon/Legends|weapon's]] effects.<ref name="Inferno">''[[Legacy of the Force: Inferno]]''</ref>
